title: Beyond Boundaries: A Comprehensive Survey of Transferable Attacks on AI Systems
abstract: arXiv:2311.11796v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Transferable attacks allow adversarial manipulations or learned attack mechanisms constructed in one setting to compromise other AI systems, potentially reducing attack costs and amplifying security and privacy risks. Yet fragmented terminology and evaluation practices hinder understanding of what transfers, why it transfers, and where transfer fails. This survey synthesizes representative research and develops a unified taxonomy spanning six complementary axes: cross-instance, cross-domain, cross-modality, cross-model, cross-task, and cross-deployment. By separating source-target configuration changes from attacker access and adaptation budgets, the taxonomy provides a common framework for comparing transfer across evasion, poisoning, backdoors, privacy inference, model stealing, and prompt-based attacks. We connect transfer mechanisms, including gradient alignment, shared representations, training persistence, and deployment

translated_title: 超越边界：AI系统可迁移攻击的综合综述
translated_abstract: 可迁移攻击使得在一个环境中构建的对抗性操纵或学习到的攻击机制能够危害其他AI系统，从而可能降低攻击成本并加剧安全与隐私风险。然而，碎片化的术语和评估实践阻碍了人们对“什么可以迁移、为什么可以迁移、迁移在何处失效”的理解。本综述综合了代表性研究，构建了一个涵盖六个互补维度的统一分类体系：跨实例、跨领域、跨模态、跨模型、跨任务和跨部署。通过将源-目标配置的变化与攻击者的访问权限和自适应预算相分离，该分类体系为比较逃逸、投毒、后门、隐私推断、模型窃取以及基于提示的攻击中的迁移现象提供了统一的框架。我们关联了梯度对齐、共享表示、训练持久性以及部署（摘要在此处截断）等迁移机制……
tldr: 本综述提出了一个涵盖跨实例、跨领域、跨模态、跨模型、跨任务和跨部署六个维度的统一分类体系，为比较AI系统中各类可迁移攻击的迁移机制与失效条件提供了通用框架。
en_tdlr: This survey establishes a unified taxonomy spanning six axes—cross-instance, cross-domain, cross-modality, cross-model, cross-task, and cross-deployment—providing a common framework for comparing transferable attacks and their mechanisms across AI systems.
